notes.title: Bouncemasters Demo Next Fest Challenge: Penguin-Launching Leaderboard!
notes.content:
Think you’re the ultimate penguin-launcher? It’s time to prove it! 
During the Next Fest (June 9–16), everyone is invited to climb to the top of the Bouncemasters Demo leaderboard.  



When the event ends on June 16, our three most legendary bouncers will earn some sweet loot:

🥇 1st Place – $25 Steam Gift Card  

🥈 2nd Place – $10 Steam Gift Card  

🥉 3rd Place – $5 Steam Gift Card



No cheating, just pure flipper-powered arcade skill and maybe a little bit of penguin luck.  

Ready, set… BOUNCE!



And don't forget to join our discord - we are building a sweet-little-pengu community there!

notes.title: Bouncemasters Demo on Steam Next Fest - LIVE!
notes.content:
